recorded-farm-operator-land-value-estima.estimatedFrom: USDA ERS, Farmland Ownership and Tenure (https://www.ers.usda.gov/topics/farm-economy/land-use-land-value-tenure/farmland-ownership-and-tenure), and USDA NASS farm real estate values. A current recorded agricultural business owner or directing farm operator in the person's home state supplies an estimated land-value exposure. An operator can lease land; this does not establish a land title, acreage, equity, or a personal wealth change.
